title: $Rg_*$ has a right adjoint for proper $g$
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category and $g\colon Z\to Y$ a proper morphism.
Then the derived pushforward

$$
Rg_*=R(g_*)\colon D(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)
$$

(the right derived functor [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] of the pushforward of
[def-sfb-finite-lower-star]) has a right adjoint, denoted $Rg^!$.

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the unconditional ambient pro-etale exceptional adjoint is false, as the current blueprint remark sk-rem-sf-fullcd-scope explains. A positive-dimensional abelian variety gives a proper pushforward that does not preserve countable coproducts. The unused legacy CompactificationUpperShriek namespace is withdrawn; the active constructible exceptional functor uses etale comparison and no declaration of that namespace. This is retirement of a false unused route, not a proof of the displayed historical statement. The unit realized arrays are empty; no active realized step is bypassed.

proof_origin.place: The counterexample and the repair boundary; Where the class adjoint stops
